# Assets — Brand Backgrounds

**Depends on**: 00-overview (brand model)
**Referenced by**: 03-semantics (brand columns), 09-open-items
**Source**: [Figma — Foundations_for-AI](https://www.figma.com/design/Afu8S0vVgbGLRWTcZCiHYG/Foundations_for-AI)

The two brands with divergent visual identity — **EVA_MB** and **EVA_DBU**
(see `00-overview.md` → Brand model) — each carry a distinct ambient
background composition, in mobile and desktop variants. HDFC does not use
this background system. Self-contained — all four images embedded as base64 directly in this file, no separate PNGs needed.

---

## EVA_MB — Mobile

`theme=nb/mb mobile` · Node `5330:24068` · [Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/Afu8S0vVgbGLRWTcZCiHYG/Foundations_for-AI?node-id=5330-24068) · 360×752

<img src="data:image/png;base64," width="360" alt="EVA_MB mobile background" />

**Layer tree**
```
FRAME "Frame 2147234834" [5330:24068] 360x752
  └── INSTANCE "Theme" [5330:24059] 360x752
        └── FRAME "BG" [I5330:24059;5299:4372] 1358x1810
              ├── RECTANGLE "64e9502e4159bed6f8f57b071db5ac7e 2" — opacity 0.5, Multiply blend, layer blur 100
              ├── FRAME "Gradient circles" — opacity 0.2 container
              │     ├── ELLIPSE "Ellipse 6469" — gradient #79b8fe → #ddd9ff, blur 300
              │     ├── ELLIPSE "Ellipse 6473" — gradient #79b8fe → #ddd9ff, blur 300
              │     ├── ELLIPSE "Ellipse 6472" — solid #34c6ef, blur 300
              │     └── ELLIPSE "Ellipse 6470" — gradient #ddd9ff → #ffffff, blur 100
              └── RECTANGLE "Rectangle 48118123" — gradient #f0f4fd → #f0f4fd
```

**Palette**: `#203ca7` (deep blue, base rect) · `#79b8fe` (sky blue) · `#ddd9ff` (lavender) · `#34c6ef` (cyan) · `#f0f4fd` (ice blue fade)

**Motion**: Figma motion/keyframe API returns empty on this node and its
instance, recursive. No native keyframe animation. If it visibly moves,
it's driven by a prototype interaction (Smart Animate), not exposed via
the read API — check the Prototype tab on this frame directly.

## EVA_MB — Desktop

## EVA_DBU — Mobile

`theme=DBU mobile` (frame "Frame 2147234833") · Node `5330:24058` · [Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/Afu8S0vVgbGLRWTcZCiHYG/Foundations_for-AI?node-id=5330-24058) · 360×800

<img src="data:image/png;base64," width="360" alt="EVA_DBU mobile background" />

**Layer tree**
```
FRAME "Frame 2147234833" [5330:24058] 360x800
  └── INSTANCE "Theme" [5330:23980] 360x800
        ├── ROUNDED-RECTANGLE "White Gradient" [I…;5299:5852]  (hidden)
        ├── FRAME "BG" [I…;5299:5853] 443x985
        │     ├── ROUNDED-RECTANGLE "image 28" [I…;5299:5854]  (hidden)
        │     ├── ROUNDED-RECTANGLE "Moving bg animation" [I…;5299:5855] 1395x1860  (hidden — see Motion below)
        │     ├── FRAME "BG" [I…;5299:5856] 2059x1574
        │     │     ├── image 2715, 64e9502e…1, dd50b693…f (hidden), Ellipse 6391/6393/6392
        │     ├── ELLIPSE "Ellipse 11117" [I…;5299:5863]
        │     └── INSTANCE "Pattern" [I…;5299:5864]  — wavy-line texture overlay
        ├── FRAME "Bottom Navigation" [I…;5299:5865]  (hidden)
        └── INSTANCE "Home Indicator" [I…;5299:5909]
```

**Motion**: unlike EVA_MB, this tree has a layer **literally named "Moving
bg animation"** (hidden, 1395×1860), sitting alongside other hidden
sibling states (`White Gradient`, `image 28`). Figma's motion API still
returns empty for it — the pattern of multiple hidden alternates strongly
suggests a **Smart Animate prototype swap** drives the motion, not native
keyframes. Confirm trigger/duration/easing in the Prototype tab.

## EVA_DBU — Desktop

`theme=DBU desktop` · Node `5299:6235` · [Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/Afu8S0vVgbGLRWTcZCiHYG/Foundations_for-AI?node-id=5299-6235) · 1050×682

<img src="data:image/png;base64," width="600" alt="EVA_DBU desktop background" />

**Layer tree**
```
SYMBOL "theme=DBU desktop" [5299:6235] 1050x682
  ├── ROUNDED-RECTANGLE "White Gradient" [5299:5911]  (visible — unlike mobile, not hidden)
  ├── FRAME "BG" [5299:5912] 3606x2716
  │     ├── image 2715, 64e9502e…1
  │     ├── ELLIPSE "Ellipse 6391" / "Ellipse 6393" / "Ellipse 6392"
  │     └── FRAME "Pattern" — 4 tiled Pattern instances (vs. 1 on mobile)
  └── FRAME "Content" [5299:5923]  (empty container)
```

**Motion**: no `"Moving bg animation"` layer or hidden alternates here —
no signal of an intended motion state at this instance. If desktop should
animate too, it likely inherits the same interaction defined at the
`Theme` component level, not this specific instance.

## Cross-brand comparison

| | EVA_MB Mobile | EVA_MB Desktop | EVA_DBU Mobile | EVA_DBU Desktop |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Named animation layer | No | No | **Yes** — hidden | No |
| Hidden alternate states | No | No | Yes (3) | No |
| Pattern overlay | No | No | Yes (1 instance) | Yes (4 tiled instances) |
| Native motion API data | Empty | Empty | Empty | Empty |
| Base composition | Blurred rect + 4 gradient ellipses | Same + 1 extra vector | Blurred rect + 3 gradient ellipses + pattern | Same, denser pattern tiling |
